candidates.description: This feature vector represents historical epochs, cultural eras, and temporal or societal descriptors.
This feature vector activates strongly on common Portuguese grammatical words and high-frequency vocabulary.
This vector fires strongly on words or proper names beginning with the letter 'a' or 'A', often appearing in multilingual contexts or as subword tokens.
This vector is related to the word root "fest" and its phonetic or morphological variations across different contexts.
This vector represents common action verbs in Portuguese.
This feature vector is primarily activated by word pieces, roots, and terms sharing the Spanish and Portuguese root sequences "cas" or "casa".
This vector represents common English word roots, prefixes, or morphological fragments frequently found in adjectives and verbs.
This vector represents the character 'á' with various diacritics and its common occurrences in accented words.
This vector activates on various combinations of closing quotation marks and punctuation marks at the ends of sentences or clauses.
